Messages.Author: Kristyl Meth
Messages.Body:
Can someone please clarify: If a vote card says: "called by any Prince or
Justicar at +1 stealth," does that mean that the vote can _only_ be called
by a Prince or Justicar, or that only a Prince or Justicar will get +1
stealth when calling the vote?

Thanks,

KM

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <01beea85$f5f0c6e0$81a5...@dapatrin.riderlaw.com>,


Only a Prince or Justicar may call the vote.
The same effect goes for any vote that says
"called by a Sabbat vampire" or "called by a Camarilla vampire"
you must be what it is to call the vote at all.

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra
